content.short: Kleoverse is a DAO tooling and credentialing platform offering on-chain badges, plus a bounty, job, and organization-finding service.
content.description: Kleoverse is a DAO tooling app and credentialing platform designed to boost efficiency for developers, community contributors, and DAOs. Its badges system issues on‑chain credentials for qualifications such as Solidity or TypeScript, helping prove skills within the ecosystem. In addition, Kleoverse offers a bounty, job, and organization finder that lets developers pursue bounties or search for full‑time and part‑time roles at Web3 companies. For developers looking to discover projects, opportunities, and collaborators in Web3, Kleoverse is a strong option.
content.meta: Kleoverse is a DAO project management and resume-building tool. Discover Kleoverse and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
